## Required checks
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] All executable code is contained in `game.html`
- [ ] No ads, analytics or trackers
- [ ] No undeclared network/camera/microphone/geolocation access
- [ ] Skills in the manifest exist in Aprincar Skill Graph
- [ ] Evidence events match actual observable tasks
- [ ] Assets and content licenses are documented
- [ ] Touch/mobile and offline behavior were tested

## Pedagogical review
Explain what the child does and what evidence is emitted. A reward/score is not evidence of mastery.
